provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific measurement/decision example; stipulated model inputs and observations, not new experimental findings.
provenance.scope: All required information, units and inferential limits are in this document.

model: Compare one unknown constant mean with a two-unknown-constant-mean model whose single breakpoint is one of the listed after-row positions. The noise variance is fixed and identical; readings are independent normal under either stipulated model. A position k puts rows1..k in the first segment and the rest in the second. Use the maximized loglikelihood improvement (RSS_constant-RSS_split)/(2*known_variance). No complexity penalty or null significance threshold is supplied. Ties within1e-10 use earlier source row.
scope: Descriptive model-based breakpoint localization for this controlled panel. This does not attribute a cause, prove exactly one physical transition or provide a false-alarm rate after breakpoint search.
